title: aphelandra modesta
intro: Aphelandra modesta, commonly known as the 'Zebra Plant', is a tropical plant species belonging to the Acanthaceae family. This plant is valued for its unique appearance and is used in traditional medicine to provide health benefits such as reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Aphelandra modesta include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various health issues. Its bioactive constituents include diterpenes and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
